say:1:1013123001:1.text: I've returned to get my family. If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have known what to do.
say:1:1013123001:1.source_cn: 这次我是回来接家人的，要不是遇到了你，我们全家真不知道...

say:2:1013123002:2.text: I did what I could. But what's your family doing here?
say:2:1013123002:2.source_cn: 我只是力所能及地做了一些小事而已，倒是你，你的家人怎么...

say:3:1013123003:1.text: The golems didn't cause this. After our home was destroyed, all we could do was try to find a new place to live. Some people went to Holistone...
say:3:1013123003:1.source_cn: 还不是魔偶闹的，家里被破坏后，我们只能四处寻找新的定居...

say:4:1013123004:1.text: Others went to Ryeham, but we had nowhere to turn, and it's not like we could go overseas with children and the elderly... Luckily, Maria's family took them in!
say:4:1013123004:1.source_cn: 有的人去了金穗村，我们家无依无靠，又不能带着老人孩子飘...

say:5:1013123005:1.text: She even dropped off some supplies now and then, seeing as everyone moved to Holistone. We may have met with misfortune, but we also met many good people. Including you, Valen!
say:5:1013123005:1.source_cn: 甚至还因为大伙搬去了圣石镇，偶尔送点物资过来。虽然我们...

say:6:1013123006:1.text: Any knight with a conscience would have done the same thing...
say:6:1013123006:1.source_cn: 有点良心的骑士，在当时的情况下，都会作出和我相同的选择……

say:8:1013123007:1.text: *Laughter* Look at Valen, lost for words after being genuinely thanked.
say:8:1013123007:1.source_cn: 哼哼！想不到维伦这种平时优哉游哉的家伙，被真心感谢了反...

say:9:1013123008:1.text: I'm not being shy, Hammie. It just feels a bit... undeserved.
say:9:1013123008:1.source_cn: 别把我说得这么可爱啊，漫漫小姐。只是觉得……多少受之有愧吧。

say:10:1013123009:2.text: The one who made the biggest difference was <style="stress"><player_name></style> here.
say:10:1013123009:2.source_cn: ……真正改变局面的人，是我们的<style=stres...
say:10:1013123009:2.male: The one who made the biggest difference was <style="stress"><player_name></style> here.
say:10:1013123009:2.female: The one who made the biggest difference was <style="stress"><player_name></style> here.

say:11:1013123010:1.text: He's the one who sorted out the exclusion edict, making the Dark Forest welcoming to refugees again. If anyone deserves thanks, it's him.
say:11:1013123010:1.source_cn: 解决了封锁令，让薄暮丛林重新开始接收难民——如果有谁值...
say:11:1013123010:1.male: He's the one who sorted out the exclusion edict, making the Dark Forest welcoming to refugees again. If anyone deserves thanks, it's him.
say:11:1013123010:1.female: She's the one who sorted out the exclusion edict, making the Dark Forest welcoming to refugees again. If anyone deserves thanks, it's her.

say:13:1013123011:1.text: Seems we owe you for giving us a place to go!
say:13:1013123011:1.source_cn: 解决了封锁令？还做到了那种事？看来大家能有去处，都是拜...
say:13:1013123011:1.male: Seems we owe you for giving us a place to go!
say:13:1013123011:1.female: Seems we owe you for giving us a place to go!
